[b]2028/1/19: Calieno-Ruiz Meets With Strømm[/b]

Prime Minister Juan Sorobzaul Calieno-Ruiz arrived early morning on Wednesday, the 19th, at Taultion Executive Airport, boarding the 3-hour flight to Tharkønn, Rosenmarkke. Calieno-Ruiz admired in awe the lavish and charming capital during his escort to the Rosenmarkket Capitol. Upon arriving, the Prime Minister was shown to the private meeting room, sitting across from Polenne Strømm. Just months prior, the two were at odds with each other, and now, they were having civil negotiations about their relations for the future.
Many topics were discussed, most of which the two sides could agree on. The two secured a deal where Lamandica would pay for Rosenmarkket oil imports, giving Lamandica another oil source and Rosenmarkke another stream of income. The two nations will allow students to travel to schools and study abroad visa-free between the two nations. Finally, the two agreed to work toward military cohesion in the future now that they are under the same alliance. Despite Calieno-Ruiz and Strømm getting along well, the two still could not agree on the terms of the Strømm Doctrine. Calieno-Ruiz is still reluctant to bend knee to the doctrine, but said he could potentially consider moving the Daesunite base in Lamandica further away from the Rosenmarkke border. Strømm stated that he could get on board with that. The two continued, ending with small-talk before the meeting ended. Calieno-Ruiz saw this meeting as a success, thanking Strømm for the cordiality and hospitality on his way out.

[spoiler= [b]Tirakan[/b]] [b]Jan 15th, 2026 - 정치 불안[/b]

[i]The Republic of Tirakan, operating under its own free will has decided to deliberately violate the 1897 Thawne Doctrine resolution, in illegally annexing territory rightfully belonging to the Kianzhouic people therefore violating their right to freedom and self determination which are all protected by Daesun under said Doctrine. Daesun, shocked by this blatant violation, has ordered a formal statement to the Republic of Tirakan in hopes of the state reversing its doings, if these actions are not taken though, Daesun also utilizes preemptive economic and military pressure to strain the Tiraki colonial presence. 

Under the Thawne Doctrine, Daesun formally issues an ultimatum to the Republic of Tirakan: transfer the colony into Daesunite administration for reintegration into Kianzhou. Failure to do so within 3 days of the formal statement will result in indisputable economic, military, and political pressure utilized by Daesun to the extent that it sees fit.  [/i]
[/spoiler]
[spoiler=[b]is[/b]][b]Jan 18th, 2026 - 격동[/b]

[i]Recognizing the potential rapid escalation of such a conflict, Daesun knew that it had to act quickly to ensure swift control over the situation before future violations of the Thawne doctrine could proliferate. All 4 branches of the PSDF would have to unilaterally collaborate to carry out a preemptive decapitation of the Tiraki colonial command, and so the genesis of military operations were posthaste approved by central military command. 

Already deployed within the Shaman Sea, the RODS Admiral Jong In Ho Carrier Strike Group (CTF-03) was quickly dispatched to the Tiraki overseas territory. The task force was composed of the RODS Admiral Jong In Ho Nimitz-class AC, 3 Sejong-class destroyers, 1 Ticonderoga-class cruiser, 3 Incheon-class frigates, 1 Virginia-class SSN, and 2 Cheonji-class AOE alongside 7,600 Haebyeongdae (marines). The task force worked to formulate a non-binding blockade of the territory, allowing for merchant ships hauling consumer goods crucial for the colony's survival into the territory, while rejecting entrance & exit to Tiraki military vessels and commercial goods. The plan was intended to put pressure onto the Tiraki government to make a decision quickly in the favor of Daesun, while also acting as an anaconda, suffocating the colony. 

On the ground, Daesun's lenient tempo shifted. An incomplete no-fly zone was declared over the territory's airspace, restricting Tiraki military aircraft from becoming airborne. A variety of KF-21s, F-35s, and F-16s were deployed to ensure such declaration, totaling over 80 foreign aircraft within Tiraki airspace. Their protocol was simple, engage once a military aircraft refused to cooperate or ground, no exceptions, no hesitation. 

Deep within the defenses of Daesunite airspace, RC-800s constantly surveyed flashzone, acting as translators between the Space Force and active fighters within the area. Utilizing Ka-band and X-band comms, the RC-800 received crucial information SBIRS and KH-11 spacecraft loitering hundreds of miles above surface regarding radar emissions, airfield locations, IF signatures, and mobile SAM deployments. All of which were fed directly to actively deployed fighters within Tiraki territory, ensuring they don't enter the flash zone blind. 

But recon wasn't the only thing the air force had to offer, back on the docks of the Admiral Jong In Ho, specialized EW KF-21 variants and EA-18G's zipped off from their docks, followed closely by F-2s providing a full array of 360° defense for the jamming squadron. Utilizing their jamming pods, the squadron worked to formulate a radar and communications jamming effort, targeting cited Tiraki SAMs, early-warning radars, and surface vessels with continuous high-volume electronic noise to overload their radars. While communications centers were hit by specialized EW KF-21 variants with WiFi spoofing, malicious packet injections, DDoS strikes, and self-replicating worms, each worked to overwhelm and compromise communications centers while also allowing Daesun to potentially tap into such a field. 

At the border, a small invasion force was prepped. The force consisted of 11,500 ground troops, 148 K2s, a variety of K21s and K200s totaling 447, and 3,000 logistical and technical armored vehicles. The intent was blatant, take out Tiraki colonial command and assume complete undeniable military authority of the territory as swiftly as possible. The attack wouldn't be blunt or diluted, but surgical and condensed. The ground war wouldn't be inaugurated by the rolling of tanks, but the roars of K9 Thunders and K239 as they released their salvo upon stolen soil. 

The invasion remained relatively "cold" within the first few hours, a plethora of K9s lined across the border battered their targets. Targeting mainly pillboxes, C2 bunkers, enemy artillery positions, and militarized chokepoints. The K9s targeted Tiraki armored deployments with KSTAM munitions, which allowed them to hit the weakest part of the selected targets with its radar-infused parachute guidance system. 

Once the invasion had hit hour 3, Daesun had shifted its pace, now operating on H-hour. Small recon crews within KUH-1 Surions were dispatched behind Tiraki lines where they could perform an incursion, take positions, notify head command about Tiraki military positions and deploy surveillance drones to further map the flashzone. But they didnt come alone, to further saturate and overwhelm Tiraki defenses, a myriad of small loitering drones hovered into Tiraki defenses, searching for easy targets such as armor, radar, and logistical positions, while also providing live feed data for both recon squads and central command. Working to support K9 kill efforts, LAH-1 Mirons waltzed into the flashzone in small groups, targeting armor while also clearing enemy chokepoints. Each assault came in successive waves, forming a spectacle of confusion and hell for Tiraki defenders. 

Once Tiraki were set into a state of confusion, it would not take long for the real ground invasion to commence. The vanguard of the invasion would be the K2s with IFV, APCs, and logistical vehicles trailing closely behind, while K30 Bihos stayed vigilant, trailing right behind to repel FPV and Kamikaze drone assaults. The protocols of the invasions remained simple, the invasion force would focus on securing as many logistical points, roads, and bridges as possible, while ignoring small arms resistance allowing for CAS to take care of them. Due to the style of such an attack, troops remained highly mechanized formulated within their spread columns of IFVs and APCs.

Back at sea, CTF-03 would finally be given the green light to begin deep strike operations once the attack was initialized. The genesis of such an assault would be characterized by the deployment of older Hyunmoo-3A variants en masse by Sejong-class destroyers against Tiraki aerial  & coastal defenses. Operating in tandem with the RC-800 and satellite guidance, each missile was en route to strike its target with surgical precision. [/i][/spoiler]
[spoiler=[b]very[/b]]
[b]Jan 19th, 2026 - 경제 혼란[/b]

[i]It had only been hours since the initial assault had begun, but Daesun did not seek to only pressure Tirakan to withdraw militarily. A combination of punitive sanctions, alliance-wide blacklisting, and capital flight methods would also be deployed against Tirakan to ensure they couldnt sustain their war effort.

The first steps to such an assault came in the form of alliance-wide pressure, utilizing its position in both the EDU and PECA, Daesun would levy for alliance-wide blanket sanctions to be authorized unto Tirakan, which would potentially deny Tirakan from the largest market in the world.

But those werent the only precautions Daesun would utilize, talks on Daesuns potential admittance into the corridor would be halted while Daesunite investors in fear of the escalating situation would sell their shares in the Tiraki northern sea program en masse, Tiraki assets within Daesun would also be immediately frozen. 

Daesun would seek to put the final nail in the coffin for Tirakis economic war effort socially, utilizing the media, Daesunite public media and private news anchors covertly funded by the Daesunite government would set high intensity long-term economic media campaigns citing Tirakans growing isolation from the East. The effort was simple, force the rich mans nerve. Fabricated economic reports, exaggerated headlines, and emotionally manipulative stances racked millions within Daesun, and continued to spread globally. The message was simple: Tirakan could only lose from here on out.  [/i][/spoiler]
